same_pid_jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

complete_instruction_binding.scope: Every executable byte matches its genuine Object except explicitly decoded BL relocations, whose actual destinations must equal captured named JIT functions in the same PID. No code is executed from an Object.

interpretation.scope: Only the active closest-parity optimization case, Seidel2D, on accepted59. No holdout diagnosis or new official performance observations.

interpretation.do_not_retry: A simple CellWrite PrivateWritesFirst extension already regressed this same numeric path to0.643974x. Global F64 SSA homes also regressed Seidel to0.900090x; ordered F64 fold SSA gave0.999766x. Retain these results and do not retry their fingerprints or merely rename those transformations.
interpretation.next_direction: Investigate a bounded source-closed point-expression prefix over one current numeric matrix view: reconstruct all pure checked coordinate subexpressions and source cell reads, establish a complete two-axis admission once at that prefix, then emit direct source-ordered F64 loads/arithmetic into the existing result/store boundary. Reuse maintained affine/closure proof and native arithmetic/scratch/error machinery where applicable. This would remove repeated per-read source guards/address/word transport rather than simply reorder the private-write branch or globally change scalar homes. Confirm actual source closure and read roles before implementation; reject effects, unsupported control, external observers or ambiguous ownership.
interpretation.required_semantics: Keep sequential in-place updates: later cells must read earlier completed writes. No independent-lane treatment of dependent adjacent outputs, reassociation/FMA or reciprocal substitution. A declined speculative prefix resumes the original lexical checked source at that same current state before any prefix effect or publication; it cannot replay an earlier mutated phase. Preserve exact first source failures, all current geometry/loans/spans/capacity/ownership/error rules, first-copy no-op behavior, original source bills/reports and atomic external outputs.
interpretation.limits: No speedup forecast, new compiler candidate, formal measurements, hardware retired-instruction/IPC/cache/traffic or RSS claims. Diagnostic residence includes output reset/drop. Stay on this target until accepted<=1.0x C; preserve all attained optimization parity wins.
